title: Retire stale imported verification satisfaction and replay concurrent uses
outcome: Retire stale imported verification satisfaction and replay concurrent uses
acceptance: An uncited imported verification use that becomes stale after source, work revision, named-root or claim/session movement no longer permanently prevents completion; its stale satisfaction stops counting and a fresh native check can satisfy the resulting obligations.
Explicitly cited stale imported acceptance still refuses completion, and foreign provenance or terminal conflicts cannot become current native authority through retirement.
Concurrent exact retries for a prepared applicability or consumption identity replay the same retained result inside the writer transaction; changed requests under a reused identity still refuse.
Meaningful focused regression tests cover stale-use completion after source/revision/handoff changes and concurrent exact retry behavior, with existing native obligation owners reused.

completion.summary: Retire uncited stale imported verification credit using current local authority and source, preserve explicit acceptance/conflict refusals, and replay exact applicability/consumption retries within the writer transaction. Eight-path repair delivered and exact carry confirmed by parent.
